---
name: havenline-environment-review
description: Review actual Havenline environment render evidence and geometry; distinguish code verification from visual approval.
---
Read Docs/Art/EnvironmentReview/ACCEPTANCE.md and the latest AGENTS.md environment escalation. For environment changes, inspect actual rendered screenshots in Docs/Art/EnvironmentReview/captures when present and the associated Actions artifacts. Use image-capable tools if available; do not claim to have opened pixels merely by reading an image filename.

Report code issues independently, then provide visual scores only for images actually inspected. Evaluate front/rear/sides, normal gameplay and closeups, night and blizzard, roof/snow/material joins, terrain contact, and camera edges. Preserve raw findings, source hashes and exact capture filenames.

For the current environment task, acceptance requires exactly 10/10 in every mandatory dimension and view and all required checks passed. This supersedes the older >9 rule. Never round scores up, average away defects, alter evidence, or repeat scoring without fixing a substantiated defect merely to obtain a pass. Invalid or unsupported model observations require verification against the pixels. Missing/low-confidence review blocks approval.

Unavailable visual inspection means UNREVIEWED, not an inferred pass. A screenshot or software-rendered benchmark cannot certify native Android 4K/60, presentation timing or thermals. Those remain separate physical-device gates. Do not modify production files or lower requirements during critique. Preserve Characters2–4 for final rigging work.
